alternatives_rejected.why: A delay fault should raise latency across the board, but own-span self-time is nearly unchanged (0.19->0.2ms) and caller-observed p50 rose only 1.16x, while caller-observed errors rose from 0 to 0.109; that error-plus-tail pattern fits drops and retransmits (E2). p90 rose about 168x versus about 10.8x for p50 (E1).
The mem deviation (z=19.48) is far smaller than the latency deviations (z=358.88, z=192.04), and own processing time is flat (E2), so request handling itself is not slowed (E1, E2).

E3 contains no logs at all, so there are no connection-refused or exhaustion lines to support this (absence of evidence, not disproof). The socket rise (z=24.36, E1) is consistent with retransmissions under packet loss.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect and remove the network impairment on emailservice pods (e.g. tc/netem loss rules or a chaos experiment), check NIC and CNI health on the node, and reschedule the pods if needed. Verify that caller-observed error rate and p90 latency return to baseline.
